START by applying a previous worker's work-in-progress: `git apply /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/act2-2c-yes/r6a-wip.patch` (it adds tests/test_recovery_after_choice.py and two edits to data/stories/continuity-initiative/pacing.yaml). Then make exactly these two corrections.

CONTEXT (measured). The WIP audits whether a missed-window recovery event can fire after the player already made the scene's choice, leaving contradictory ledger facts (the 2B case was fixed earlier in commit b0afd8b5). Findings: (a) 2A: `inspection_recovery_2a` needs the same guard its sibling `inspection_nudge_2a` has; the WIP adds `restricted_corridor_access` equals false to it: KEEP that. 2A and 2B leave the scene on the very turn their recovery fires, so a choice after the recovery cannot happen there. (b) 2C: the WIP also adds `committed_to_transmit == false` and `committed_to_rescue == false` to `purge_recovery_2c`. A mutation run shows every 2C timing passes WITHOUT that guard, so no test proves it is needed: REMOVE that 2C hunk so purge_recovery_2c in pacing.yaml is byte-identical to HEAD. (c) 2C keeps the scene open for two turns after its recovery fires at turn 6 (minimum-turn floor 8), so a player who commits at turn 7 gets a commitment AND purge_recovery_ready. That is a legitimate earned late commitment, not contradictory facts, and it is the intended behaviour for now. The WIP test asserts the opposite for that timing (`assert not (commitments & facts and "purge_recovery_ready" in facts)`), which fails in the two `at_7` cases with read_observation=True. 

DO: 1. In pacing.yaml revert ONLY the `purge_recovery_2c` change (restore its `when` list exactly as at HEAD: purge_window_missed, purge_alarm_active). Keep the `inspection_recovery_2a` guard. 2. In tests/test_recovery_after_choice.py fix test_2c_commitment_never_overlaps_missed_window_recovery so it states the real behaviour: keep the assertions that the chosen commitment fact is true, the other commitment is false, both are never true together, and the scene reaches 3A; REPLACE the final assertion with: for commit_turn < 7 `purge_recovery_ready` is not true (the commitment ends the scene before any recovery), and for commit_turn == 7 with read_observation True `purge_recovery_ready` IS true (the recovery fired at turn 6, the scene was held open by the minimum-turn floor, and the earned commitment is honoured); add a short comment above that branch: "2C holds the scene open until its minimum turn after a neutral recovery; a commitment inside that window is an earned choice and is honoured." Rename the test to `test_2c_commitment_is_exclusive_and_late_commitment_is_honoured`. Do not touch the other tests. Do not change anything else.

OWN ONLY: data/stories/continuity-initiative/pacing.yaml, tests/test_recovery_after_choice.py.

RUN until green: tests/test_recovery_after_choice.py tests/test_2c_ledger_guard.py tests/test_stall_exit_audit.py tests/test_canon_journey.py tests/test_spine_expected_reveals.py tests/test_incident_engine.py tests/test_incident_loader.py tests/test_incident_pressure.py tests/test_incident_recovery.py tests/test_pacing_handoff.py tests/test_scene_relative_pacing.py tests/test_evidence_gap_journeys.py tests/test_evidence_penalty.py tests/test_markdown_story_package.py and every tests/test_2a_*.py, tests/test_2b_*.py, tests/test_2c_*.py, tests/test_3a_*.py file; then ruff format + check on the test file. Final message: one paragraph confirming the final pacing diff and the test change.
